content.title: Something Very Bad Is Going to Happen (TV Mini Series 2026) ⭐ 6.8 | Drama, Horror
content.text: Episodes8Videos3Featured reviewsI do NOT understand the hateI was EXTREMELY hesitant to watch this after the reviews I read. Even though, leading up to its release, I was anticipating it. Majority of the reviews I have come across on here speak negatively regarding this series and encourage you not to waste your time. I'm here to say, "USE YOUR OWN JUDGEMENT!" I am so glad I gave in and watched it! Is it perfect, no, is it bad, no! As a horror buff, I completely respect it and found it to be woth the watch. I was actually pleased after viewing, thinking about the fact that you rarely see something like this released outside of October. I'm here to address some things I've read- Yes, the lighting does make it hard to watch unless you are watching it in the dark Yes, there is an unexpected shift towards the middle of the story, but I was not necessarily turned off by it.I actually enjoyed the fact that everything you think you know or expect after esp 1 & 2 change. I do not agree with the peoplepsayimg it is a knock off of Ready or Not (love that movie!).I actually enjoyed it more after going into it with the negative reviews because it caused me to lower my standards from where it was. I literally only found 1 plot whole that was never explained, and truthfully, I let my imagination and context clues assume why it took place( regarding her in the trunk eps 1) I truly believe this was enjoyable and entertaining. I literally expected it to be terrible based off what others were saying, I'm glad I choose to view it myself. I literally stayed up all night and binged it because I wanted to know what happened. No, the something bad was not that it was created in the first place. Give it a shot till the end and make up your own mind.Very strong startIf you are looking for a great horror show then you will love the first 3 eps and then the story develops into a more slightly comical drama.The story does keep you watching and the dialogue is well written.The lead actress definitely holds the entire show.I don't regret watching this. It is a binge worthy series but I was looking for a great horror and it don't deliver on that.Worth watchingThis series wasn't as bad as people are saying. It's slow, seem like it's dragging, but the story did intrigue me. Usually i would've stopped watching after the first episode, but the mystery kept me going and i wanted to know how it would end and what was the plot twist. The acting is actually really decent with a few, well known, actors. I don't think it deserve 1 star at all. Nowadays, people can't sit in front of a show without wanting full actions, explosions, bad CGI. This wasn't it but it was quite intriguing.I would suggest not relying on the bad reviews and just decide for yourself.Here comes the bride or..Was good,not original or clichéd still was an interesting series.. Tried to come across artsy or stylish film noir,but didn't execute it overall that well.I do feel many parts or episodes could of been shortened,as it felt redundant or dragged out.. Rather mixed over conclusion/ending,far as was it satisfying or not.There didn't seem to be any sizable plotholes,except as mentioned clichéd over the(no spoilers)storyline topic/reveal.Casting to acting decent,cinematography & sound/music fine.. Did you care really enough,for anyone or their survival -vs- demise?When seen initially was about a bride or eccentric family,thought it was going to be a Ready or Not movie version.Not something will rewatch,but a popcorn flick for a weekend.Something Very Bad Is Going to Happen (2026): Wedding Jitters, Dread, and a Pleasant SurpriseNetflix's Something Very Bad Is Going to Happen is a 2026 horror series built around a simple but effective premise: a bride becomes increasingly convinced that something terrible is waiting for her at the altar. The show is an eight-episode Netflix horror drama starring Camila Morrone, Adam DiMarco, and Jennifer Jason Leigh.I'll be honest, I'm already overwhelmed with the amount of television I'm trying to keep up with, so this was one of those series I could easily have ignored. I'm actually quite pleased that I decided to give it a go, because it turned out to be far more decent than I expected. In a time when there is so much content fighting for attention, this series managed to stand out just enough through its atmosphere, polished presentation, and a story that keeps your interest without feeling completely overblown.One of the first things that struck me was how well produced it is. This is not some scrappy, half-baked effort that relies purely on a spooky title and a moody trailer. The production value is solid throughout. Everything feels carefully assembled, from the look of the locations to the pacing of the tension. It has that glossy, polished Netflix finish, but thankfully it does not feel empty underneath the surface. There is a proper sense of craft here. The show looks good, sounds good, and, most importantly, knows how to maintain an uneasy mood.The story itself is very good. It takes familiar horror ideas - dread, paranoia, uneasy family dynamics, the feeling that disaster is inching closer - and presents them in a way that remains engaging. It may not reinvent the genre, but it does not need to. What it does well is build anticipation. It creates that steady feeling that something is off, and it keeps feeding that feeling episode by episode. That alone is enough to make it worth watching, especially if you enjoy horror that leans more into tension and atmosphere than constant chaos.The cast may not be packed with huge names, but that actually works in the show's favour. Sometimes a series benefits from not feeling overloaded with familiar faces. It allows the viewer to settle more naturally into the world of the story. That said, Jennifer Jason Leigh is definitely a standout. She has always been a very good actress, and once again she brings a presence that instantly adds weight to the screen. Even when the material around her is restrained, she has that ability to make a moment feel sharper, stranger, or more significant. She is one of those performers who can elevate a scene just by the way she carries herself.Overall, Something Very Bad Is Going to Happen was a pleasant surprise. It is well acted, well produced, and confidently told. More importantly, it justified the time I gave it, which is more than can be said for a lot of modern series. When you are drowning in endless viewing options, it is always satisfying to come across a show that actually feels worth the investment. This one may not be a masterpiece, but it is polished, atmospheric, and consistently watchable - and that is more than enough to make it a success in my eyes.The Best New and Upcoming HorrorThe Best New and Upcoming HorrorWe've rounded up the horror movies and series coming to screens both big and small all the way into 2027.See the listMore like thisRelated interestsContribute to this pageSuggest an edit or add missing contentEdit pageAdd episode
